protocol.study: S3 mixed-variable MOTPE versus random and NSGA-II; matched wall-time evidence
protocol.hypervolume_policy: Configured trials only plus fixed anchor; exclude presets, stored and references
protocol.wall_time_scope: After common four controls: optimizer setup, ask/cache/feedback, native encoding, three-decoder validation, corpus/source guards and ledger I/O
protocol.common_horizon: Minimum observed configured-search completion time across all nine studies; do not extrapolate stopped runs
protocol.order: Rotate strategy order by seed; serialize every native measurement
protocol.gpu_decision: Retain CPU fallback: latent model failed prediction/calibration and fit-parity gates; bound end-to-end upside from actual optimizer setup/ask/feedback time
protocol.promotion: none; freeze finalists before S9, no reserved-test encoding

corpus.test_policy: 14 original full synthetic cases reserved; no real final test in this study
corpus.validation_policy: previously visible full real holdout plus larger synthetic validation; regression only

limitations: equal unique budgets and wall checkpoints within observed runs; no extrapolation after study termination
three seeds are a bounded pilot; ranges must be retained, no significance claim
MOTPE uses log2 integer probes and conditional insertion; NSGA-II uses categorical values; domain is the same 880 configurations
shared compile and four-control costs precede search clocks and are reported separately
whole-loop clocks include oracle and source/corpus checks; encoder-only paired clocks remain separate
optimizer bound assumes all timed optimizer work vanished; it is not a GPU speedup measurement
